blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—The Narvacan National Central High School (NNCHS) in this province won three championship titles and a third-place finish at the International Robolution Dubai held on Nov. 14 and 15 at the BITS Pilani Dubai Campus in the United Arab Emirates. The Ilocos Sur school’s delegation topped the Erobo Quiz Bee – High School Category, Emegasumo v1.5, and E-Soccerbot – Teacher Category, while placing third in the E-Soccerbot – Student Category.
